title: PromptContract
description: A PromptContract owns a tool's LLM-visible description and per-parameter docstrings. One contract per tool. Files in prompts/tools/*.json validate against this shape.

contractId.description: Stable identifier for telemetry and registry lookup. Convention: <toolName>_v<n>.

version.description: Semver string. Bumped when the contract's data shape changes.

toolName.description: Tool the contract describes. Must match a registered tool name from enums/tool-names.json.

baseDescription.description: Default description shown to the LLM when this tool is visible.

parameterDocs.description: Per-parameter docstrings keyed by parameter name.

voiceExamples.description: Tool-specific voice or style examples (e.g. screenplay format for video).

conditionalNotes.description: Conditional description fragments keyed by signal name. Appended to the baked description when the corresponding signal is present in the turn policy.
